Chapter 827: Chapter 25 Understanding The Void (Happy 61, Subscribe Request)_3

Chapter 827: Chapter 25 Understanding the Void (Happy 61, Subscribe Request)_3

Lin Yuan’s spiritual willpower index has already reached its limit. Continuing to kill these Void Creature Monarchs no longer yields any improvement.

Just as Lin Yuan’s spiritual willpower index exceeded ten million points, killing those ordinary Void Creatures also failed to produce any effect.

“What a pity, these Void Creatures originate from the dimensional gaps and cannot enter other dimensions, otherwise they would vanish into thin air.”

Thinking to himself, Lin Yuan had discovered this rule early on when the Taiyang Divine Spirit first entered the Void Secret Realm and killed the first Void Creature.

That is, Void Creatures can’t enter the Boundless Void.

Strictly speaking, the Void Secret Realm is a ‘net’ formed from the Boundless Void towards the dimensional gaps and is essentially still within the dimensional gaps.

...

Thus, Void Creatures can survive in the Secret Realm, simply unable to leave.

But that’s all there is to it. Any Void Creature that truly enters the dimension of the Boundless Void will irreversibly perish, no matter what method or means of isolation are used.

This is also why Lin Yuan has never seen these Void Creatures outside of the Void Secret Realm.

And if they can’t even enter the Boundless Void, let alone the Chaos Void where the Main Universe is located, this makes Lin Yuan quite regretful.

You see, killing these Void Creatures directly and significantly enhances the strength of spiritual willpower. Such an event in the Main Universe would be nothing short of a fantasy.

At least, with Lin Yuan’s current status in human civilization, he has never heard of such treasures. There are means to enhance spiritual willpower, but a significant enhancement?

And such a straightforward significant enhancement without any theoretical basis.

That is to say, if Lin Yuan could bring these Void Creatures to the Main Universe, even if he does not wish to aid enemies, merely exchanging within human civilization, he could obtain unimaginable merit points and Twelve-Star treasures.

There’s no doubt, those Tenth and Eleventh Stage Evolvers of human civilization would spare no expense to enhance their spiritual willpower, even just a little bit.

As for the amount of World-Breaking Origin Force needed to bring Void Creatures from the Boundless Void back to the Main Universe? As long as the gain is substantial enough, Lin Yuan wouldn’t mind spending the World-Breaking Origin Force to do so.

Essentially, the World-Breaking Origin Force is a type of resource, and this resource is renewable.

Unfortunately, Void Creatures can’t survive in any dimension, which means Lin Yuan’s idea of trading between two realms is directly thwarted.

…

Even if Lin Yuan cannot bring Void Creatures to the Main Universe, he has ways to let the human Evolvers of the Main Universe enjoy the most direct enhancement of spiritual willpower by killing Void Creatures.

That is to directly bring them to the Boundless Void, enter the Void Secret Realm, and then kill those Void Creatures.

The Myriad Realms Gate can transport physical bodies, and can also carry items from the Main Universe. Naturally, it is also capable of bringing other life forms to the traversed worlds.

It’s merely a question of how much World-Breaking Origin Force is consumed.

Since Void Creatures cannot leave, then let human civilization Evolvers from the Main Universe come here.

But this method is very risky and can easily expose the secret of the Myriad Realms Gate.

Means of traversing different dimensions, even those beings close to a Perfect Time Being cannot achieve it directly, and Lin Yuan easily did it? And brought someone along?

The Myriad Realms Gate is Lin Yuan’s biggest trump card, far surpassing Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Demon Jade Space, and others; it absolutely must not be revealed even a bit.

That’s why, even though this method is highly feasible and the potential gains are immense, relying on Lin Yuan’s connection with the Tianqing World, bringing one human civilization Evolver over and consuming at most a couple strands of World-Breaking Origin Force is possible.

And the gains might be the vast majority of that Evolver’s lifetime savings.

But Lin Yuan absolutely wouldn’t take such a risk.

Even in the future, when Lin Yuan becomes the ultimate being, he won’t proceed with such an action.

If able to step into the ultimate realm, Lin Yuan might choose to reveal the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but the Myriad Realms Gate? Better not.

…

“The remaining Void Creature Monarchs can stay here.”

Lin Yuan finally glanced at the space inside the boulder, then took a step and disappeared on the spot.

Next.

Lin Yuan began to traverse the Void Secret Realm, carefully experiencing every detail of this realm.

With his sixth realm of temporal sensation, Lin Yuan could see through everything in the Void Secret Realm at a glance, but seeing through doesn’t mean it’s not helpful.

With the aid of the Void Secret Realm, Lin Yuan could observe the path taken by the realm’s creator.

Although that creator failed in their attempt to reach the ultimate, reaching the Tenth Stage means potential is not an issue; failing to reach the ultimate cannot deny this point.

After all, failing to reach the ultimate involves various factors, and bad luck is very likely.

After spending five years, Lin Yuan explored every corner of the Void Secret Realm.

He then began exploring the entire Boundless Void.

Compared to the Void Secret Realm, the Boundless Void is much simpler, but it drained more of Lin Yuan’s energy.

After all, the Void Secret Realm is artificially created, even if it contains the path of a Tenth Stage existence, it can’t compare to the Boundless Void itself.

Five years passed again.

Lin Yuan traversed the entire Boundless Void.

Then and there, Lin Yuan casually chose a place to sit cross-legged, observation coming to an end, now pausing to reflect deeply and convert everything he had seen and felt into his own gains.

At this moment, in a corner of the vast Boundless Void, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, sorting through his own insights.

Having naturally observed spiritual epiphanies occurring, and after ten years of observation, all of everything converged in his chest, he quickly comprehended using his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

[Your understanding is against heaven; observing the void has greatly increased your comprehension of the Life and Death Samsara Rule…]

…

[Your understanding is against heaven; observing the void has greatly increased your comprehension of the Great Destruction Rule…]

…

[Your understanding is against heaven; observing the void has greatly increased your comprehension of the Causality Fluctuation Rules…]
